label: Possibly, CONCRETE_AND_ABSTRACT_6 contingents exist in a history where each has an earlier ground
paraphrase: OPEN analyst possibility premise, attribution deferred: some history accessible from the selected world has a contingent concrete individual present at some moment; every contingent concrete individual existing there has a concrete ground existing there under the supplied grounding relation; and every ground of a contingent concrete individual is present at a moment strictly before each moment at which that individual is present (no merely simultaneous grounding). Nothing is said about the actual world, well-founded grounding, or the length of the past.
